name: Speed
description: Where the time goes on each page of the shop: engine start, database, outside calls, each module's hooks, and the rest — per page, per module and per query, with repeated queries (N+1) traced to the line that asked, and a timeline of the slowest pages. Measures a share of real requests, costs nothing on the others.

settings.label: Measure the shop
settings.help: Off: nothing is measured and nothing is written — the only cost left is one setting read per request.

settings.label: Share of requests measured, %
settings.help: A measured request costs a few milliseconds of bookkeeping and a few rows written after the page is sent. A quiet shop can measure everything (100); a busy one learns just as much from 5.

settings.label: Keep a timeline of pages slower than, ms
settings.help: A measured page slower than this keeps its full timeline — every query, call and hook in order — to open later.

settings.label: A query repeated on one page this often is suspect
settings.help: The same query shape asked again and again while one page is built is almost always a loop asking one row at a time (N+1). It is listed with the line of code that asked.

settings.label: Keep measurements for, days
settings.help: Older hours, queries and timelines are removed every night.

keywords.en: performance slow profiler queries N+1 timing
